SELECT r.fiscal_period_label, r.period_start_date, r.period_end_date, r.weeks_in_period, r.first_fiscal_week, r.last_fiscal_week,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date) AS rows_in_period,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT week_ending_date) FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date) AS weeks_present,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN r.period_start_date AND r.period_end_date GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_groups
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar r WHERE r.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND r.fiscal_period IN (10,11,12)

calls.statement:
SELECT w.week_ending_date, count(*) rows_, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_rows, min(s.is_current::INT) , count(DISTINCT w.store_key) store_keys
FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
WHERE w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND cs.region='West' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
chk AS (
    SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, w.week_ending_date, count(*) c
    FROM dedup w JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=w.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
    GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM chk) AS multi_version_groups, (SELECT count(*) FROM dedup) AS dedup_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22') AS raw_rows

WITH dedup AS (
    -- the 2026-03-08 snapshot was loaded twice with identical values; keep one row per store_key, product_key, week
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT cp.category, w.week_ending_date, SUM(w.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM dedup w
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = w.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = w.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cs.region = 'West' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur, count(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
